invariant: Core ConfigureNotify reports only authorized sibling IDs and preserves each recipient's correct byte order. Filtering does not change a privileged recipient's packet.

Corrected nearest-authorized sibling metadata in both byte orders.
Privileged recipients retain their original event.
Debug and core-X native-server ASan/UBSan on both hosts.
Related input, identity, resource, selection and extension checks.
limitations: This component covers ConfigureNotify sibling metadata.
